artifact_review: The Router flagged 'blur' (severity 4) and 'text_gibberish' (severity 3). However, the Image Text Auditor found NO text blocks, which supports the 'text_gibberish' observation: the markings on the hull are likely AI-generated pseudo-text that failed to resolve into recognizable characters, rather than just blurry real text. The 'texture_anomaly' in the background is consistent with low-res generative artifacts. I agree with the Router that these are artifacts, but the 'blur' itself is not necessarily an AI artifact, whereas the 'text failure' and 'background smear' are stronger signals of generation issues.

The image conforms well to the general class prototype but lacks the fine-grained structural completeness of a high-fidelity generation.

The combination of illegible pseudo-text and smeared background textures lowers the artifact score significantly below the reference 'high' quality, but it is better than the 'low' reference which had catastrophic structural failures.
